ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 40% high-intensity (white/light-grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated in the central and inferior regions of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large, contiguous white patch extending from the base toward the mid-trailing edge. The right lobe contains a similar white region, which is sharply bisected by a vertical dark linear streak. Dark pixels dominate the distal tips and the entire perimeter of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) are visible along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe tip displays larger, more irregular jaggedness compared to the finer serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters are visible near the peduncle-fluke junction and scattered within the lower central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, singular dark vertical line (rake mark) on the right lobe. Multiple parallel, fine vertical dark lines are visible on the far left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the right lobe; irregular, possibly traumatic, jagged erosion at the distal edge of the right lobe tip.
